classification: Predeclared designed structural experiments; not empirical validation and not the R39 fully code-frozen holdout
policy_class: One common randomized Markov policy, all-state all-date operating constraints
retention: Retain every specified case, including solver failures, failed transfer conditions, and non-closures.
comparison: Compare unreduced and structure-eliminated formulations of the identical LP. Classical LP presolve is an equally entitled structural comparator; no claim of superiority over the best presolved solver.
trust_boundaries: Exact rational arithmetic checks finite certificates. Atomic measure-preservation and aggregation identities are mathematical proofs, not machine-checked theorems. The original action-dependent affine and bilinear maintenance models are retained and not relabeled solved.
